options.content:
PRAXEN // ROUTING
● LIVE
why are traffic, model choice, cost and policy behaving this way?  //  posture · provider→model · local↔cloud · per-model · service tier · cost · prompt cache · jev gate · local watchdog · envelopes
StatusOKWATCHCRIT Boards COMMAND ROUTING FORENSICS

panels.title: ROUTE SUCCESS
panels.description: Share of model calls the proxy completed successfully in the selected time range. Under 99% deserves a look; under 90% something is failing repeatedly. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: FALLBACK SHARE
panels.description: Fallbacks as a percentage of all model calls in the range — how often the first choice did not work out. Amber past 2%, red past 10%. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: OFF-TIER SHARE
panels.description: Percentage of successful calls that were billed at a premium speed tier without being asked for (same rule as the COMMAND tile: named -priority routes and router-chosen premium lanes count as opt-in). Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model','') ~ '-priority$')) / NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "off_tier_pct" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND status = 'success' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$'

panels.title: LOCAL SHARE
panels.description: Share of successful calls answered by LM Studio on your own machines instead of a cloud provider. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: CACHE READ RATIO
panels.description: How much of the prompt text the providers served from their prompt caches instead of re-processing it, as a share of all prompt tokens. Higher is cheaper. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((100.0 * sum(COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cached_tokens')::bigint, (metadata->'usage_object'->>'cache_read_input_tokens')::bigint, 0)) / NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "cache_read_pct" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND status = 'success' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$'

panels.title: JEV REFUSALS CAUGHT
panels.description: Share of judged answers that the Jev judge flagged as a refusal or an empty non-answer and sent on to the next model in the chain.

panels.title: Provider → Model // success calls (range)
panels.description: How successful calls flowed from each provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, local LM Studio, the private cloud) to the model that actually answered, over the selected range. Thicker ribbons carry more calls. The 14 busiest models are shown; the rest are grouped into one line.

panels.title: Local ↔ Cloud // token flow (range)
panels.description: Tokens split between what stayed on this machine (local, costs nothing) and what went to the cloud, then by the route that was asked for. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: Per-model telemetry // requests · tokens · latency · TTFT · tok/s · cost · success (range)
panels.description: One row per model or route name exactly as clients asked for it: requests, tokens in and out, average time to answer and to first token, output speed, dollars, and the share that succeeded. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: Time to First Token (heatmap)
panels.description: How long streamed answers took to produce their first token, over time. Darker cells mean more requests landed at that delay. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: Upstream latency P95 by model group
panels.description: How long the provider itself took to answer, per route; 95 out of 100 requests were faster than the line. The proxy's own overhead is not included here — COMMAND's P95 is the end-to-end number. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: Service tier truth // route · billed tier · x vs standard rate (range)
panels.description: Which speed tier each route was actually billed at, and what that cost compared with the standard rate for the same tokens. 'opt-in lane' means the premium was chosen on purpose (a -priority route, or the router choosing one); 'OFF-TIER' means it was not. A 'priority' row at 1.00x means the vendor was asked for priority but did not apply it. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    model_group,
    custom_llm_provider AS provider,
    COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model','') AS routed_model,
    metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' AS tier,
    spend,
    prompt_tokens,
    completion_tokens,
    COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cached_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cached_tok,
    COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cache_creation_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cache_write_tok,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'input_cost_per_token')::float AS in_rate,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'output_cost_per_token')::float AS out_rate,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'cache_read_input_token_cost')::float AS cr_rate,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'cache_creation_input_token_cost')::float AS cw_rate,
    "startTime"
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
    AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$'
    AND metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' IS NOT NULL
),
x AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN in_rate IS NOT NULL AND out_rate IS NOT NULL THEN
      GREATEST(prompt_tokens - cached_tok - cache_write_tok, 0) * in_rate
      + cached_tok * COALESCE(cr_rate, in_rate)
      + cache_write_tok * COALESCE(cw_rate, in_rate)
      + completion_tokens * out_rate
    END AS std_usd
  FROM r
)
SELECT
  model_group AS "route",
  provider,
  tier,
  CASE WHEN tier IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR bool_or(routed_model ~ '-priority$')) THEN 'OFF-TIER ⚠'
       WHEN tier IN ('priority','fast') THEN 'opt-in lane'
       WHEN tier = 'flex' THEN 'discount'
       ELSE 'standard' END AS "verdict",
  count(*) AS "calls",
  sum(prompt_tokens) AS "in_tok",
  sum(completion_tokens) AS "out_tok",
  round(sum(spend)::numeric, 5) AS "billed_usd",
  round(sum(std_usd)::numeric, 5) AS "std_rate_usd",
  round((sum(spend) / NULLIF(sum(std_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS "x_vs_standard",
  max("startTime") AS "last_seen"
FROM x
GROUP BY model_group, provider, tier
ORDER BY (tier IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR bool_or(routed_model ~ '-priority$'))) DESC, "x_vs_standard" DESC NULLS LAST, sum(spend) DESC

panels.title: Cost by model // spend (range)
panels.description: Dollars spent per model over the range, largest first, from the proxy's live counters (these restart with the proxy; the request log on FORENSICS is the ledger). Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: Prompt cache // reads · writes · read ratio · est. $ saved (range)
panels.description: Per model: how many calls hit the prompt cache, tokens read from and written to it, the read share, and an estimated dollar saving worked out from the price the proxy recorded on each call. Models with no cache activity are hidden. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

targets.rawSql: WITH r AS (SELECT model, prompt_tokens, COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cached_tokens')::bigint, (metadata->'usage_object'->>'cache_read_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS read_tok, COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cache_creation_tokens')::bigint, (metadata->'usage_object'->>'cache_creation_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS write_tok, (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'input_cost_per_token')::float AS in_rate, (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'cache_read_input_token_cost')::float AS cr_rate FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$') SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE read_tok > 0) AS cache_hits, sum(read_tok) AS read_tok, sum(write_tok) AS write_tok, round((100.0 * sum(read_tok) / NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens), 0))::numeric, 1) AS read_ratio_pct, round(sum(read_tok * (in_rate - COALESCE(cr_rate, in_rate)))::numeric, 4) AS est_usd_saved FROM r GROUP BY model HAVING sum(read_tok) > 0 OR sum(write_tok) > 0 ORDER BY sum(read_tok) DESC

panels.title: Advised routes // spend by route · logged at executor rate (⚠ advisor premium under-counted)
panels.description: Spend on the advised routes (where a second, stronger model advises the answering model). The proxy logs the advisor's tokens at the cheaper answering model's rate, so the real bill is higher than shown. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  model_group AS "route",
  count(*) AS "calls",
  sum(prompt_tokens) AS "in_tok",
  sum(completion_tokens) AS "out_tok",
  round(sum(spend)::numeric, 4) AS "logged_usd_exec_rate",
  round((sum(spend) / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric, 5) AS "avg_usd_call"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND model_group ~ '-advised'
GROUP BY model_group
ORDER BY sum(spend) DESC

panels.title: JEV CALLS // classifier · judge · errors (range)
panels.description: How many times the Jev decision service was asked to classify a prompt or judge an answer, and how many of those calls failed (time-outs, key or circuit-breaker problems). When Jev fails, routing falls back to the built-in scorer and answers pass through unjudged.

panels.title: SOFT REFUSALS CAUGHT (range)
panels.description: Answers the Jev judge flagged as a refusal or as an empty non-answer, which then fell back to the next model.

panels.title: JEV EST. SPEND (range)
panels.description: Estimated dollars spent on Jev calls in the range.

panels.title: Jev latency p50 / p95 by purpose
panels.description: How long Jev takes to decide — the typical case (p50) and the slow end (p95) — for classifying prompts and for judging answers.

panels.title: Classifier tier mix // praxen/openai-router
panels.description: Which complexity tier the classifier assigned to prompts on the OpenAI router, over time. SIMPLE and MEDIUM go to the cheaper standard-tier models; COMPLEX and REASONING to the premium lanes.

panels.title: Judge verdicts // group · verdict · action (range)
panels.description: Every judge verdict by route: answered, refused or non-answer, and whether the answer passed through or triggered a fallback.

panels.title: Jev decisions // JSON events (classifier · judge · errors)
panels.description: The raw Jev decision events from the proxy log, newest first, one JSON line each.

panels.title: LM STUDIO LANE // success calls (range)
panels.description: Successful calls answered by LM Studio (any machine you point a local route at) in the range. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

panels.title: Local tier // served-id activity + last_seen
panels.description: Which local models actually answered, how often, how long they took on average, and when each was last used. Respects the KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  model AS "served_id",
  count(*) AS "calls",
  sum(prompt_tokens) AS "in_tok",
  sum(completion_tokens) AS "out_tok",
  round(avg(request_duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS "avg_ms",
  max("startTime") AS "last_seen"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_base LIKE '%1234%' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY max("startTime") DESC

panels.title: Team envelope consumed // % of max_budget (live from LiteLLM Postgres)
panels.description: How much of each team's monthly hard stop has been used, from the proxy's own counters. At 100% the team's keys are refused until the monthly reset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT team_alias AS "team",
       ROUND((100 * spend / NULLIF(max_budget,0))::numeric, 1) AS "pct_consumed"
FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable"
WHERE max_budget IS NOT NULL AND max_budget > 0
ORDER BY max_budget DESC

panels.title: Key lanes // last seen · calls (range) · MTD $ · watch line · hard cap
panels.description: One row per API key: when it was last used, calls in the range, dollars this month, its share of the $40 plan (the watch line) and how far along it is, and its hard cap. Watch lines warn; hard caps refuse.

targets.rawSql: WITH watch(alias, line) AS (VALUES ('research-agent', 24.0), ('apps-frontend', 8.0), ('apps-private-lane', 5.0), ('sandbox-probe', 3.0)) SELECT v.key_alias AS "key", COALESCE(v.team_id,'-') AS team, MAX(s."startTime") AS last_seen, COUNT(s.request_id) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")) AS calls_range, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.spend) FILTER (WHERE s."startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), 0)::numeric, 4) AS mtd_usd, w.line AS watch_line_usd, ROUND((100 * COALESCE(SUM(s.spend) FILTER (WHERE s."startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), 0) / NULLIF(w.line, 0))::numeric, 1) AS watch_pct, v.max_budget AS hard_cap_usd, ROUND((100 * COALESCE(v.spend, 0) / NULLIF(v.max_budget, 0))::numeric, 1) AS cap_pct FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v LEFT JOIN watch w ON w.alias = v.key_alias LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s ON s.api_key = v.token WHERE COALESCE(v.key_alias,'') <> '' GROUP BY v.key_alias, v.team_id, w.line, v.max_budget, v.spend ORDER BY mtd_usd DESC, v.key_alias
